node.statement: Choose a basis of V adapted to the finite invariant filtration W_0 superset W_1 superset ... superset W_{k+1}=0. The matrix of sigma^{*k} is block triangular with diagonal blocks the induced maps on W_p/W_{p+1}; hence Tr(sigma^{*k}|V)=sum_{p=0}^k Tr(sigma^{*k}|W_p/W_{p+1})=(-1)^k sum_{p=0}^k dim_reals(W_p/W_{p+1}).
